cells.gaps: The newest row (LSO-001, August 2024) is a request for proposals for the NISSA registry and its management system, valued underway; it does not say the registry stopped, and the April 2024 statement that NISSA holds 90% of households stands as in service. No source names two or more programmes selecting from it, or a link to the national ID.
cells.note: The ministry said in April 2024 that NISSA holds 488,000 households, 90% of the country's, in all 10 districts, which meets stage 3. Stage 4 needs a source saying two or more programmes select from it.
